name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded a Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, and wired up the CopilotKit provider, runtime handler, and `CopilotSidebar` component per the quickstart docs. TypeScript type-checking passed cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0). However, the production build (`next build`) was killed by the system—log shows "Killed" after "Creating an optimized production build ..."—so I never reached a running server or verified the `/api/copilotkit` endpoint responds. The blocker appears to be an out-of-memory condition during the Turbopack build.
